title: Table levitation at family seances

tellings.quote: we actually had paranormal phenomenon we were kids
it a few times, like the table knocking
tellings.difference: Describes table knocking rather than levitation, with no time or place given.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same table phenomena from Levenda's early sessions that telling 7 describes.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author and historian, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that as kids in the Bronx, New York, around 1965 and 1966, he and his family had paranormal things happen during seances, gatherings meant to contact spirits. He describes the table rising up, though in another telling he speaks only of table knocking, with no time or place given. If true, it would mean that something unseen was answering them.
